current_profile_snapshot.scope_note: Project-controlled broad Rock baseline; not a universal definition of Rock.
current_profile_snapshot.groove_behavior: straight or lightly syncopated eighth-note rock pulse; backbeat remains structural but fills and pushes vary by section
current_profile_snapshot.phrase_behavior: 4- or 8-bar phrases with verse/chorus contrast, fills into boundaries, and selective lead call/response
current_profile_snapshot.harmony_behavior: tonal major/minor; power-chord, triadic, modal or blues-derived vocabulary; progression must vary across pieces
current_profile_snapshot.bass_behavior: electric bass locks with kick while retaining independent melodic movement; roots/fifths are a baseline, not a fixed template
current_profile_snapshot.percussion_behavior_if_applicable: kick/snare backbeat, hi-hat/ride timekeeping, tom/crash transitions; pattern variation required across sections
current_profile_snapshot.instrument_role_behavior: electric guitar rhythm + lead, electric bass, drum kit; optional acoustic guitar, keys, brass/strings via target resources
current_profile_snapshot.ensemble_player_behavior: rhythm section shares groove hierarchy; lead phrases leave space and answer vocal/melodic gaps
current_profile_snapshot.arrangement_transformation: verse/chorus or sectional builds; density, register and guitar texture change across sections
current_profile_snapshot.dynamic_behavior: firm but section-shaped; choruses may lift, breakdowns reduce density
current_profile_snapshot.articulation_behavior: guitar attacks, sustains, mutes, accents and slides follow role; drums use distinct backbeat/fill articulation
current_profile_snapshot.timing_humanization_behavior: shared groove offsets and phrase pushes; no independent random jitter
current_profile_snapshot.continuous_performance_control: velocity + expression + note length + target articulation controls
current_profile_snapshot.sound_effects_intent: amp/drive/reverb/delay are style resources, not mandatory; preserve bass clarity
current_profile_snapshot.mix_prominence_intent: kick/bass/rhythm foundation clear; lead present selectively rather than constantly
current_profile_snapshot.production_mastering_intent: punchy transients, controlled low-end, no automatic loudness flattening
current_profile_snapshot.manufacturer_adapter_requirements: map canonical guitars/bass/drums to target voices; do not replace genre because a patch is missing
